title: Haritaki (Terminalia chebula Retz.) - Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for Haritaki fruit used as an ingredient in Ayurvedic medicines, including foreign matter, loss on drying, ash values and extractive values.

title: Ashvagandha (Withania somnifera L. Dunal) - Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for Ashvagandha root used as an ingredient in Ayurvedic medicines.

title: Haridra (Curcuma longa L.) - Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for Haridra (turmeric) rhizome used as an ingredient in Ayurvedic medicines.

title: Amalaki (Phyllanthus emblica L.) Dried Fruit - Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for dried Amalaki fruit used as an ingredient in Ayurvedic medicines.

title: Cotton Yoga Mat - Specification
scope: Specifies constructional/physical and chemical requirements for cotton yoga mats including yarn count, thickness, weight, breaking strength, pH of aqueous extract, colour fastness and anti-bacterial activity.

title: Panchakarma Equipment Part 1 - Droni - Specification
scope: Specifies material, shape, dimensions, manufacture, finish and test requirements for Droni (Panchakarma treatment table) equipment.

title: Panchakarma Equipment Part 2 - Shirodhara Yantra - Specification
scope: Specifies material, shape, dimensions, manufacture, finish and staining test requirements for Shirodhara yantra equipment used in Panchakarma.

parameters.Material: Stand, vessel and chain as specified

title: Yoga Centre - Service Requirements
scope: Specifies general and specific service requirements for Yoga centres including management, class conduct, physical environment/safety, admission, feedback and complaint handling processes.

parameters.Scope: Service quality requirements, not a product test standard

title: Determination of Pesticide Residue in Herbal Materials - Test Method
scope: Specifies test methods to determine pesticide residue limits in herbs used as ingredients in traditional medicines.

parameters.Scope: Test method standard for pesticide residue limits

title: Stainless Steel Neti Pot - Specification
scope: Draft specification for stainless steel Neti Pot used in Shatkarma/Ayurvedic nasal cleansing procedures.

title: Tourism and Related Services - Medical Tourism - Service Requirements
scope: Modified adoption of ISO 22525:2020 with inclusion of Ayush-related provisions, covering procedure options, treatment facilities, tourism arrangements, insurance and related provisions for Medical Value Tourism.

parameters.Scope: Service requirement standard, no chemical/physical parameters

title: Protective Helmets for Two-Wheeler Riders - Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for protective helmets for two-wheeler riders including shock absorption, penetration resistance, retention system strength and field of vision.

title: Safety of Toys Part 1 - Mechanical and Physical Properties
scope: Specifies mechanical and physical safety requirements for toys, including small parts, sharp edges/points and structural integrity, to prevent choking and injury hazards.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) - Specification
scope: Specifies quality, safety and labelling requirements for packaged drinking water including microbiological, chemical and physical parameters.

title: Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) Cylinders - Specification
scope: Specifies material, design, construction, testing and marking requirements for LPG cylinders used for domestic and commercial purposes.

title: Ordinary Portland Cement - Specification
scope: Specifies physical and chemical requirements for 33 grade Ordinary Portland Cement, including compressive strength, setting time and fineness.

title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - General Requirements
scope: Specifies general safety requirements for household and similar electrical appliances covering protection against electric shock, mechanical hazards and heat resistance.

title: PVC Insulated (Heavy Duty) Electric Cables - Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for PVC insulated heavy duty electric cables for voltages up to 1100V.

title: Metallic Materials - Tensile Testing at Ambient Temperature
scope: Specifies the method for tensile testing of metallic materials at room temperature, used as a reference test method across many product standards.

parameters.Scope: Test method standard, referenced by other product standards

title: Glossary of Ayurvedic Terminology - Fundamental Principles
scope: Standardized terminology for fundamental principles of Ayurveda, part of a 5-part glossary series.
